title: Gemma 4 mixture-of-experts text decoder (gemma4) from a GGUF, over the device plugins
description: Gemma 4's text decoder (Gemma4ForConditionalGeneration's language model, transformers' modeling_gemma4): 5:1 sliding-window (1024, 8 KV heads x 256, RoPE theta 1e4) and full-attention layers (2 KV heads x 512, keys and values from one projection, proportional RoPE theta 1e6 over a quarter of the pairs), query and key norms, attention scale 1, a dense GeGLU MLP beside 128 routed GeGLU experts (top 8 of a softmax router over the RMS-normed, scaled residual, renormalized, times a per-expert scale) with their own pre and post norms, a per-layer output scale, the embedding scaled by sqrt(hidden) and tied to the head, final logits soft-capped at 30. Weights read from the GGUF as stored (gguf-projections, gguf-experts) or, for the tests, from a dense state dict; KV in gemma4-attention's sliding rings and derived-key pages; every step of many sequences one batch, each prompt chunk alone and decode rows 8 at a time.

chunk_schedule.description: POSITION:ROWS,...: from each position on a prompt chunk computes at most ROWS rows (prefill_chunk before)

context.description: positions served when the loader names no context

host_experts.description: comma-separated layers whose routed experts live in pinned host memory (the placement's experts.LL. groups)

workspace_mib.description: device MiB planned for a step's temporaries (decoded matrices, attention blocks, logits)

reserve_mib.description: device MiB left out of the placement budget (CUDA context, the desktop, the run's headroom)

decode_graphs.description: capture the decode step per row count in CUDA graphs at load

overlap.description: run a layer's routed experts on a side stream beside its dense MLP (forked and joined inside the step, captured graphs included)
